note.question: When is more merrier?
note.overview: This study proposes a method to reduce the cost for acquiring impressions for location-based, mobile advertising firms. Such firms act on behalf of advertisers to execute mobile, in-app, ad campaigns. Ad space is sold on ad exchanges that auction impressions one-at-a-time, on a real-time basis.

source.quote: This study proposes a method to reduce the cost for acquiring impressions for location-based, mobile advertising firms.

Therefore, in practice, ad firms must balance the procurement cost and the capacity cost to minimize the expected total cost of acquiring the supply of the ad space: (1) the set of ad exchanges to obtain its supply from, and (2) the bidding policy used for each ad exchange at each location.
The ad firm needs to determine the set of ad exchanges to procure the supply and determine how much to bid on supply provided by each ad exchange such that the expected total cost is minimized.
Supply-side agents are mobile ad exchanges (e.g., DoubleClick, Nexage, AppNexus) that help the app own­ ers to monetize their ad space.
For r ∈R, let pi,r denote the probability that an impression from location r arrives in a time slot via ad exchange i.
Consider a situation where an ad firm commits to adver­ tisers to display a specified number of ads, in a specified set of geographic locations, during a given time horizon.
This study focuses on a problem where an ad firm com­ mits to fulfill the demand for impressions (ad spaces) required by a set of advertisers.
